meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: MUST USE when asked to find, read, list, search, inspect, fetch, export, or reconstruct coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude Code/Desktop, OpenCode, Senpi/pi, oh-my-pi (omp), gajae-code (gjc), OpenClaw, Factory Droid, Amp, Gemini/Kimi/Qwen CLIs, Codebuff, Roo/Kilo/Cline, Kodu, Cursor CLI, Aider, Aside browser-agent sessions, or unknown local agent logs. Covers transcripts, session IDs, rollout JSONL, state SQLite, Claude projects/pre-compact histories, OpenCode messages/parts, child/subagent linkage, cwd/model/time/token filters, archives, and cost clues. Expands fuzzy recall into parallel query lanes and first probes known stores so absent platforms are skipped cheaply. Triggers: coding agent sessions, Codex/Claude/OpenCode/Senpi/pi/oh-my-pi/omp/gajae-code/gjc/OpenClaw/Droid/Amp/Kodu/Cursor/Aider/Aside sessions, transcript search, session history, session ID, read transcript, token usage, subagent sessions, what did I do yesterday, did we already do this.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速查找和浏览AI编码助手的会话历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常使用多个AI编码工具并需要追溯之前的开发对话
copy.tagline_en: Quickly find and browse session history of AI coding assistants
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use multiple AI coding tools and need to trace back previous development conversations

howto.what: 安装后，当你想了解过去的编码工作时，Claude会先搜索本地各工具的会话记录，而不是凭记忆回答。它能列出匹配的会话，按时间、目录、模型等筛选，并读取选中会话的完整转录。
howto.when: 当用户要求查找、阅读、列出等操作本地编码代理会话，或问“我昨天做了什么”等回忆问题时触发。

say.text: 找出昨天修复登录页的会话记录。
say.note: Claude会搜索并列出匹配的会话。

say.text: 搜索所有提到“支付接口”的编码会话。
say.note: Claude会并行查找并返回相关会话列表。

say.text: 读取上次部署失败的那个会话。
say.note: Claude会读取该会话的完整转录。

howto.what_en: Searches local coding-tool session logs (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, etc.) to answer memory questions; lists/filters sessions and reads full transcripts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to find, read, or list coding-agent sessions, or when recalling past work like 'what did I do yesterday'.

say_en.text: Find the session where I fixed the login page yesterday.
say_en.note: Claude will search and list matching sessions.

say_en.text: Search coding sessions mentioning the payment API.
say_en.note: Claude will search in parallel and return a list.

say_en.text: Read the session of the last failed deploy.
say_en.note: Claude will read the full transcript of that session.
